rows.text: forms the entry `02ADD990 + ecx*0x3D0 + r8d*0xF0` (both indexes sign-extended); when `edx` is -1 stores 2 in its dword `+0xE8`; otherwise reads the zero-extended word `+0x28 + edx*0x60` of the qword at `02ADD980 + ecx*0x3D0`, converts it to float, adds 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) and stores the result at the entry's float `+8`
